method: Finite sum over every possible binomial count; deterministic numerical probability integration/inversion; no Monte Carlo sampling.
uncertainty_scope: The analysis assumes independently known marginal calibration and kappa. It does not include uncertainty in fitted marginal parameters, trial dependence, temporal drift, or uncertainty in a physiological mapping.
negative_control_scope: Target inclusion under a deliberately false contract is not valid confidence coverage. The resampling target is per-task variance rather than a shared component.
no_power_claim: No recommended human sample size, source-study power, anatomical mediator, or consciousness-theory validation is inferred.
